white_hart.name: The White Hart
white_hart.greeting: You have kept the account where a living hand can reach it. That is something the old oath would not allow.
lines: Kael: The grain condition is broken. No one standing here has to promise you anything to eat.
The White Hart: I remember the gate shut. I remember the road hidden. I remember the soldiers entering. I will not tell you those were one man's act.
Kael: The copies survive. I will keep them. Some people said no when I asked them to stand beside me. Their answer stays no.
The White Hart: Then begin with your own hands. Do not fill the empty places with another person's vow.
The White Hart: Make the account public and I will leave its judgment with you. Release me quietly and preserve the record without opening every private memory.
The White Hart: Or carry the unresolved binding yourself. Or destroy me and lose what no copy holds.
Kael: Whatever I choose, the order stays in the book. Families still need a road home. Edric still has to answer.
The White Hart: Then choose whose work begins when mine ends.

actions.label: Witness — make the account public; stay to preserve it.
actions.preview: Release the Hart through public acknowledgment and Kael's willing work to preserve the record.
actions.cost: Lost privilege, trade pressure, and the ongoing labor of restitution. Fewer allies mean more work for Kael.

actions.label: Mercy — release the Hart; safeguard names and private memories.
actions.preview: Release the Hart while protecting private memories; institutional crimes remain on record.
actions.cost: A protected circle must preserve the truth; partial public acknowledgment leaves unresolved grievances.

actions.label: Duty — freely carry the unresolved binding myself.
actions.preview: Kael willingly carries the continuing binding. No other person is pledged.
actions.cost: Kael loses freedom and rest. The village gains time while the injustice remains unfinished.

actions.label: Ash — destroy the Hart; keep the human record and face the loss.
actions.preview: Destroy the complete witness by combat; the copied human record survives.
actions.cost: Irreplaceable memories are lost. Dispersal harms the land and future harvests.

actions.label: Concord — share stewardship with the keepers who freely agreed.
actions.preview: Care, logistics and the records each have a willing keeper. Each person confirms their own terms; Kael cannot pledge another person.
actions.cost: Continuing obligations can be withdrawn. An uncovered route closes; care and copying wait. The original agreements remain history, not permanent claims.

actions.label: Open Road — relinquish the old shelter and lead the community to the refuge.
actions.preview: Respect the signed household requests and each named person's separate answer. Dismantle the ward, lead the willing households through the prepared passage, and settle them at Hearthward.
actions.cost: Lose the old supernatural shelter and access to the Hart's complete account. The new home still needs protection and work.

variants.greeting: You have kept the account where a living hand can reach it. That is something the old oath would not allow.

The White Hart: Or carry the unresolved binding yourself. Or destroy me and lose what no copy holds.

Kael: The kitchen is working. There is a route and a dry refuge. We have tried the shifts, not just written them down.
The White Hart: Then there are two more things you may attempt. Share stewardship only with the keepers who still freely offer it. An empty place remains empty until somebody chooses it.
Kael: And if we leave?
The White Hart: Carry the people and their human records through the prepared passage. Undo this boundary, and its shelter will not follow. Neither will the complete account I hold.
Kael: A rota can fail. A refuge can fail. Neither makes the old choices disappear.
The White Hart: Then choose whose work begins when mine ends.

aftermath_names_concord.name: Anwen
aftermath_names_concord.greeting: There are spaces beside the names now. For the next shift, and for anyone who needs to stop.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: Who fills a space when somebody leaves?

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: Someone who offers. We ask. We wait. If nobody can, we write that the work is uncovered.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Anwen checks the recorded answers against the current rota. Every withdrawal stays a vacancy. No household disappears from the meal list.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: The Hart did not make the work smaller.

lines.speaker: Anwen
lines.text: No. It can no longer make one person carry it in silence.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Beside the public account, the rota records the next handover. The protected pages remain sealed under their owners' terms.

unattended_pages.speaker: The public work
unattended_pages.text: The public rota leaves uncovered shifts visible. Food and shelter remain available to households whether or not a name appears beside a responsibility.

unattended_pages.speaker: The public work
unattended_pages.text: The copied orders stay open to scrutiny. Private statements stay under their owners' terms; the new arrangement does not release them into public custody.

aftermath_work_concord.name: Tor and Rook
aftermath_work_concord.greeting: The first shared week has already needed a repair.

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: A hinge, a rail, and the kitchen latch. Those are the jobs. Nobody promised the iron would stop wearing out.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: The rota leaves a gap for weather. Sensible. Weather has never signed anything I gave it.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: And if a keeper withdraws?

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: We close the unsafe part until somebody can do it. A promise is not a brace.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rook checks the marked strap before loading. Tor leaves the repair tools where the next willing worker can find them.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Your shift is still on the board. Unless you have something to tell the board.

unattended_pages.speaker: The public work
unattended_pages.text: Repair tools wait beside a marked strap and a list of worn joints. The next willing worker can see both the task and the space left for weather.

unattended_pages.speaker: The public work
unattended_pages.text: An uncovered shift is still written as uncovered. An unsafe part of the route can close until someone freely takes the work; a promise cannot brace a rail.

aftermath_road_concord.name: Nera
aftermath_road_concord.greeting: The passage is open. The watch still changes at the posted hour.

lines.speaker: Nera
lines.text: Some people stayed. Some went on. Their shares were packed either way.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: Do the keepers agree about everything?

lines.speaker: Nera
lines.text: They agree about the next handover. Tomorrow we may have to talk again.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: At the landing, one worker finishes while another checks the route marks. The work has owners; the road does not have a new lord.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: Then we keep the empty places visible.

lines.speaker: Nera
lines.text: And we ask before writing a name in one.

unattended_pages.speaker: The public work
unattended_pages.text: The public route marks name the next handover. Household shares are packed for people staying and people going on; neither choice appoints a keeper.

unattended_pages.speaker: The public work
unattended_pages.text: Uncovered shifts remain visible beside the agreed ones. The community has a way to ask for help, not a right to fill the spaces with other people's names.

aftermath_names_open_road.name: The departing record
aftermath_names_open_road.greeting: The public notice gives the location of the copies at Hearthward. The old oath cannot keep them here.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: The orders, the signatures and the accounts we recovered are packed. These are human records. They remain evidence.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: What is missing?

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: What only the Hart remembered. We cannot fill that absence by guessing.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Vale checks the sealed envelopes against their owners' instructions. The departure list records places needed, not testimony owed.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: Leave the notice where someone returning can find it.

lines.speaker: Vale
lines.text: A road to the record. Not a claim that we carried everything.

unattended_pages.speaker: The public work
unattended_pages.text: A public notice points toward the copied orders at Hearthward. Human records survive the departure. Nothing on the notice claims to contain the Hart's complete account.

unattended_pages.speaker: The public work
unattended_pages.text: Sealed statements remain subject to their owners' terms. The departure list records the places needed without demanding testimony from the people using them.

aftermath_work_open_road.name: The last load
aftermath_work_open_road.greeting: The households and their last load have reached Hearthward. The old walls remain without the ward.

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: Dry tools underneath. Sleeping cloths on top. Nobody should have to unpack a whole cart to lie down.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: I would prefer a lighter future. This one has cooking pots.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: What stays?

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: The walls. What we cannot carry. The people who freely chose another road know where we are going.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The straps are empty now. The households who requested relocation have reached their prepared beds; no departing name was added without its own agreement.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: The pots have arrived. Tomorrow somebody still has to cook.

unattended_pages.speaker: The public work
unattended_pages.text: The households and their belongings have reached Hearthward over the prepared passage. The old walls remain without the supernatural shelter. Human watch and repairs must now keep the refuge safe.

unattended_pages.speaker: The public work
unattended_pages.text: The walls remain. A notice gives the refuge's location for anyone returning. The people who stay behind have not been entered into a promise to follow.

aftermath_road_open_road.name: The open road
aftermath_road_open_road.greeting: Beyond the old boundary, the route marks continue toward Hearthward.

lines.speaker: Nera
lines.text: The refuge has beds. It has no oath around it. We keep watch with people now.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: Can the road remain open behind us?

lines.speaker: Nera
lines.text: While we maintain it. Whoever comes later deserves to know both where it goes and what it costs.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The boundary stones remain dark. At Hearthward, ordinary lanterns light the settled households. No return to Greyfen restores the old ward or the Hart's complete account.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: And the Hart?

lines.speaker: Nera
lines.text: We chose to leave its shelter and its full account. Keep the copies dry. Do not call them the whole of what we lost.

unattended_pages.speaker: The public work
unattended_pages.text: The route marks continue toward the prepared refuge. An ordinary lantern identifies the next turn; no new oath binds the people travelling beneath it.

unattended_pages.speaker: The public work
unattended_pages.text: The copied human record can be carried and checked. The Hart's complete account was not copied, and the open road makes no claim to restore what was lost.

chapters.title: The Empty Tables
chapters.question: Who can eat when the mill's promises no longer feed them?
chapters.summary: At the old river landing, Nessa, Elna and Toma prepare a kitchen and dry sleeping places. The households disagree about where food should be held, but nobody must give testimony to receive it.
chapters.stakes: A common kitchen saves fuel and concentrates work. Household distribution preserves independence but asks more of the carriers.

chapters.title: A Road Kept Open
chapters.question: What kind of passage can people keep working together?
chapters.summary: Nera measures the crossing while Rook reads the current and Tor examines the old joints. A public bridge and an escorted ferry are both possible; neither maintains itself.
chapters.stakes: A repaired crossing stays open between patrols but needs watch and repairs. A ferry needs less timber, but people must wait for its crew and weather.

chapters.title: The House of Many Names
chapters.question: Can a house keep an honest account without demanding its occupants' stories?
chapters.summary: Anwen and Mira inspect an upland refuge while Vale separates the public account from private testimony. Beds, medicine and a dry shelf come before names in a book.
chapters.stakes: Distributed public copies resist a single keeper's failure. Protected custody limits exposure but depends on fewer people. Shelter is unconditional in either arrangement.

chapters.title: What We Promise
chapters.question: Which responsibilities will people actually choose, and how can they leave them?
chapters.summary: The community tests a meal round, a night alarm and a record handover. Merrow, Edric and any surviving, willing Senn answer for the powers they still hold. Kael can offer his own work, never somebody else's assent.
chapters.stakes: A rota is useful only while its keepers can refuse, rest and withdraw. Missing volunteers leave work unfinished; they do not lose food or shelter.

endings.title: Concord
endings.intention: Distribute stewardship among the keepers who have each explicitly agreed.
endings.benefit: Care, passage and the records have several willing owners instead of one indispensable bearer.
endings.cost: The shifts continue. Keepers can withdraw; an empty shift leaves the community vulnerable until another person freely accepts it.
endings.minimum: All four community chapters and currently consenting keepers for care, logistics and record-keeping.
endings.procedure: Each keeper confirms their own terms. Kael accepts his own work and cannot fill a vacancy with somebody else's name.

endings.title: Open Road
endings.intention: Dismantle the territorial protection and lead the dependent community to the prepared refuge.
endings.benefit: The community can leave with its human evidence, supplies and a working route.
endings.cost: The old supernatural shelter is lost, and the Hart's complete account becomes inaccessible. The new refuge still needs labor and protection.
endings.minimum: All four community chapters, a working evacuation route and a prepared refuge.
endings.procedure: Secure the copied human records, open the prepared departure, and dismantle the boundary only after the dependent households can leave.

share: The names entered here belong only to people who agreed. Each keeper may leave the work; the promise gives nobody the right to appoint a replacement in their silence.
Kael sets the record beside separate keys. Care, the road and the copies have different keepers. None can close the whole account, and none inherits another person's burden.
The Hart rests while the first willing watch begins. Kael takes his turn among the others. This arrangement will need meetings, spare hands and difficult answers long after tonight.
depart: The water carrier's household and the sweeper's household have asked to leave the failing shelter for Hearthward. Kael reads their signed requests. Named companions travel only if they separately agreed; nobody else's silence becomes consent.

Kael unfastens the boundary stones. Their light goes out. Greyfen loses the old supernatural shelter, and the Hart withdraws with the complete account that no copy contains. The human orders, signatures and protected testimony remain intact.
Take the departure load to Lantern Reach

The boundary will not rise again. The households wait with their belongings at Lantern Reach. Kael must lead them over the prepared passage and bring them to the dry refuge. Until they arrive, this choice is unfinished.

ending_cards.share:
CONCORD
The willing keepers divide care, passage and memory. Their initial acceptance remains in the record, but their continuing obligations can be withdrawn in person. A withdrawal leaves a real vacancy: uncovered care and copying wait, and an unstaffed public crossing closes until a keeper freely returns. Food, shelter and a safe service footway remain available. Kael cannot assign a replacement or erase a refusal. Meetings and handovers take time; the arrangement protects no one from the work of keeping it voluntary.
ending_cards.depart:
OPEN ROAD
The territorial ward is dismantled. The dependent households who requested relocation cross the prepared route and reach Hearthward with their belongings and the recovered human evidence. Only named people who personally agreed relocate with them; everyone else's answer remains their own. Greyfen's supernatural shelter is gone, and access to the Hart's complete account is lost. The refuge has ordinary walls, beds and a human watch. Those who remain at the old home know its protection will not return. The copies preserve proven responsibility and private terms, without pretending to contain everything that was lost.

concord.text: The rota shows what is covered and what is vacant. We ask before we put a name in either place.

open_road.text: The households reached Hearthward. There's no ward there, or here now. We have the copies; the rest of the Hart's memory is gone.
